keyEvents.text: Goal! Lyon 1, Angers 0. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Corentin Tolisso.
Substitution, Lyon. Kaïl Boudache replaces Julien Duranville.
Substitution, Angers. Harouna Djibirin replaces Haris Belkebla.
Substitution, Angers. Usman Simbakoli replaces Prosper Peter.
Substitution, Lyon. Noah Nartey replaces Mads Bidstrup.
Substitution, Lyon. Khalis Merah replaces Ernest Nuamah.
Substitution, Angers. Louis Mouton replaces Branco van den Boomen.
Substitution, Angers. Jim Allevinah replaces Lilian Raolisoa.
Substitution, Angers. Anthony Bermont replaces Amine Sbaï.
Goal! Lyon 2, Angers 0. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Felix Bacher following a corner.
Substitution, Lyon. Nicolás Tagliafico replaces Corentin Tolisso.
Jordan Lefort (Angers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
